        "contents": "        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Permissions\n    func requestLocationPermission() {\n        switch locationManager.authorizationStatus {\n        case .notDetermined:\n            locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()\n        case .authorizedWhenInUse:\n            locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n        default:\n            break\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded() {\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n        if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n            switch status {\n            case .notDetermined:\n                // Trigger first-time prompt\n                locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()\n            case .authorizedWhenInUse:\n                // Escalate to Always once if user opted-in to tracking\n                if !hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization {\n                    debugLog(\"Ensuring Always authorization after WhenInUse…\")\n                    hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization = true\n                    locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n                }\n            default:\n                break\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Tracking Control\n    func startTracking() {\n        debugLog(\"startTracking called\")\n        isTracking = true\n        updateTrackingMode()\n    }\n    \n    func stopTracking() {\n        debugLog(\"stopTracking called\")\n        isTracking = false\n        locationManager.stopUpdatingLocation()\n        locationManager.stopMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges()\n        stopForegroundLocationTimer()\n    }\n    \n    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState",

Properties\n    @Published var disableDeviceAutolock: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(disableDeviceAutolock, forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) }\n    }\n    @Published var indicateAccuracyOnMap: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(indicateAccuracyOnMap, forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) }\n    }\n    @Published var groupsZoomToFit: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(groupsZoomToFit, forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) }\n    }\n    @Published var miataruServerURL: String {\n        didSet {\n            defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(\n                serverURL: miataruServerURL,\n                deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\n                ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var trackAndReportLocation: Bool {\n        didSet { \n            defaults.set(trackAndReportLocation, forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation)\n            // Check location permissions when tracking is enabled\n            if trackAndReportLocation {\n                checkAndRequestLocationPermissions()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var saveLocationHistoryOnServer: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(saveLocationHistoryOnServer, forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) }\n    }\n    @Published var locationDataRetentionTime: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(locationDataRetentionTime), forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") }\n    }\n    @Published var mapType: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapType), forKey: Keys.mapType) }\n    }\n    @Published var mapUpdateInterval: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapUpdateInterval), forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) }",

        "contents": "- Unit tests for business logic\n- UI tests for critical flows\n- Multi-device testing\n- Permission flow verification\n\n## 🔒 Privacy &amp; Security\n\n### Data Protection\n- Location data encryption\n- User consent requirements\n- Data retention policies\n- GDPR compliance\n\n### Permission Management\n- Minimal permission requests\n- Clear permission explanations\n- Graceful permission denial\n- User control over data\n\n## 📊 Performance Considerations\n\n### Battery Optimization\n- Smart location updates\n- Background task management\n- Auto-lock control\n- Energy-efficient operations\n\n### Memory Management\n- Proper observer cleanup\n- Weak reference usage\n- Resource deallocation\n- Memory leak prevention\n\n## 🚀 Deployment &amp; Distribution\n\n### Build Requirements\n- Xcode 16.0+\n- iOS 18.0+ deployment target\n- Swift 5+\n- macOS 14.0+ (development)\n\n### Distribution\n- App Store distribution\n- TestFlight beta testing\n- Enterprise deployment support\n- Universal binary support\n\n## 🔧 Common Development Tasks\n\n### Adding Features\n1. Create platform-specific views\n2. Implement business logic in managers\n3. Update settings if needed\n4. Add localization strings\n5. Test on all platforms\n\n### Debugging\n- Location simulation in Xcode\n- Permission status checking\n- Battery usage monitoring\n- Background task verification\n\n### Performance Tuning\n- Instruments profiling\n- Memory usage analysis\n- Battery impact assessment\n- Background task optimization\n\n## 📚 Resources &amp; References\n\n### Documentation\n- [SwiftUI Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui)\n- [CoreLocation Framework](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corelocation)\n- [iOS Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines)\n\n### Dependencies\n- **CodeScanner**: QR code scanning\n- **MiataruAPIClient** (via local &#96;Libraries/MiataruClientSwift&#96;): API client\n- **QRCode**: QR generation\n- **SwiftImageReadWrite**: Image handling\n\n## 🎯 Future Roadmap\n\n### Planned Features\n- Enhanced privacy controls\n- Advanced device grouping\n- Improved battery optimization",
        "signatures": {},

Properties\n    @Published var disableDeviceAutolock: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(disableDeviceAutolock, forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) }\n    }\n    @Published var indicateAccuracyOnMap: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(indicateAccuracyOnMap, forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) }\n    }\n    @Published var groupsZoomToFit: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(groupsZoomToFit, forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) }\n    }\n    @Published var miataruServerURL: String {\n        didSet {\n            defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(\n                serverURL: miataruServerURL,\n                deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\n                ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var trackAndReportLocation: Bool {\n        didSet { \n            defaults.set(trackAndReportLocation, forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation)\n            // Check location permissions when tracking is enabled\n            if trackAndReportLocation {\n                checkAndRequestLocationPermissions()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var saveLocationHistoryOnServer: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(saveLocationHistoryOnServer, forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) }\n    }\n    @Published var locationDataRetentionTime: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(locationDataRetentionTime), forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") }\n    }\n    @Published var mapType: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapType), forKey: Keys.mapType) }\n    }\n    @Published var mapUpdateInterval: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapUpdateInterval), forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) }",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Permissions\n    func requestLocationPermission() {\n        switch locationManager.authorizationStatus {\n        case .notDetermined:\n            locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()\n        case .authorizedWhenInUse:\n            locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n        default:\n            break\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded() {\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n        if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n            switch status {\n            case .notDetermined:\n                // Trigger first-time prompt\n                locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()\n            case .authorizedWhenInUse:\n                // Escalate to Always once if user opted-in to tracking\n                if !hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization {\n                    debugLog(\"Ensuring Always authorization after WhenInUse…\")\n                    hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization = true\n                    locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n                }\n            default:\n                break\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Tracking Control\n    func startTracking() {\n        debugLog(\"startTracking called\")\n        isTracking = true\n        updateTrackingMode()\n    }\n    \n    func stopTracking() {\n        debugLog(\"stopTracking called\")\n        isTracking = false\n        locationManager.stopUpdatingLocation()\n        locationManager.stopMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges()\n        stopForegroundLocationTimer()\n    }\n    \n    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState",

Bool ?? false\n        self.indicateAccuracyOnMap = d.object(forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) as? Bool ?? true\n        self.groupsZoomToFit = d.object(forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) as? Bool ?? true\n        self.miataruServerURL = d.string(forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL) ?? \"https://service.miataru.com\"\n        self.trackAndReportLocation = d.object(forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.saveLocationHistoryOnServer = d.object(forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.locationDataRetentionTime = Int(d.string(forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") ?? \"1440\") ?? 1440\n        self.mapType = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.mapType) ?? \"1\") ?? 1\n        self.mapUpdateInterval = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) ?? \"30\") ?? 30\n        self.mapZoomLevel = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.mapZoomLevel) ?? \"1\") ?? 1\n        self.historyNumberOfDays = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.historyNumberOfDays) ?? \"10000000\") ?? 10000000\n        self.locationActivityType = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.locationActivityType) ?? \"0\") ?? 0\n        self.locationSensitivityLevel = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.locationSensitivityLevel) ?? \"2\") ?? 2\n        self.autoRefreshDeviceList = d.object(forKey: Keys.autoRefreshDeviceList) as? Bool ?? true\n        self.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices = d.object(forKey: Keys.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices) as? **Zusammenfassung:**
1. **Lokalisierungsschlüssel** von "Enable Location Tracking" zu "Location Tracking" geändert
2. **Alle Übersetzungen aktualisiert:**
   - Englisch: "Location Tracking"
   - Dänisch: "Lokationssporing" (statt "Aktivér lokationssporing")
   - Deutsch: "Standortverfolgung" (statt "Standortverfolgung aktivieren")
   - Spanisch: "Seguimiento de ubicación" (statt "Activar el seguimiento de ubicación")

        "contents": "    \n    @objc private func appDidBecomeActive() {\n        debugLog(\"App did become active\")\n        // Re-check permission escalation / first-time prompt if needed\n        ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded()\n        if isTracking {\n            startHighAccuracyUpdates()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Settings Observer\n    private func observeSettings() {\n        settings.$trackAndReportLocation\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] shouldTrack in\n                guard let self else { return }\n                if shouldTrack {\n                    self.startTracking()\n                } else {\n                    self.stopTracking()\n                }\n            }\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private func observeActivityType() {\n        settings.$locationActivityType\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] newValue in\n                guard let self = self else { return }\n                self.locationManager.activityType = Self.activityTypeFrom(newValue)\n                if self.isTracking {\n                    // Restart location updates to apply new activityType immediately\n                    self.updateTrackingMode()\n                }\n            }\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private static func activityTypeFrom(_ value: Int) -&gt; CLActivityType {\n        switch value {\n        case 1: return .automotiveNavigation\n        case 2: return .fitness\n        case 3: return .otherNavigation\n        case 4:\n#if swift(&gt;=5.0)\n            if #available(iOS 12.0, *) {\n                return .airborne\n            } else {\n                return .other\n            }\n#else\n            return .other\n#endif\n        default: return .other\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Permissions",

## Zusammenfassung der Änderungen

**Problem:** Wenn der Benutzer die Standortberechtigung verweigert, bleibt der Toggle auf "an", obwohl das Tracking gestoppt wird, weil `settings.trackAndReportLocation` weiterhin `true` ist.

**Lösung:** Der Code setzt `settings.trackAndReportLocation` automatisch auf `false`, wenn die Berechtigung verweigert oder eingeschränkt wird. Dies erfolgt an zwei Stellen:

1. Im `didChangeAuthorization`-Delegate: Wenn der Status auf `.denied` oder `.restricted` wechselt, wird `trackAndReportLocation` sofort auf `false` gesetzt.
2. In `updateTrackingMode()`: Zusätzliche Sicherheit, falls diese Methode von anderer Stelle aufgerufen wird.

**Ablauf:**
- Benutzer aktiviert den Toggle → `trackAndReportLocation = true` → Berechtigungsdialog erscheint
- Benutzer verweigert Berechtigung → `didChangeAuthorization` wird mit `.denied` aufgerufen
- `trackAndReportLocation` wird automatisch auf `false` gesetzt
- Der Toggle zeigt jetzt "aus" und spiegelt den tatsächlichen Berechtigungsstatus wider

Der Toggle zeigt nun korrekt an, ob Standort-Tracking aktiviert ist oder nicht.

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Permissions\n    func requestLocationPermission() {\n        switch locationManager.authorizationStatus {\n        case .notDetermined:\n            locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()\n        case .authorizedWhenInUse:\n            locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n        default:\n            break\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded() {\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n        if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n            switch status {\n            case .notDetermined:\n                // Trigger first-time prompt\n                locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()\n            case .authorizedWhenInUse:\n                // Escalate to Always once if user opted-in to tracking\n                if !hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization {\n                    debugLog(\"Ensuring Always authorization after WhenInUse…\")\n                    hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization = true\n                    locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n                }\n            default:\n                break\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Tracking Control\n    func startTracking() {\n        debugLog(\"startTracking called\")\n        isTracking = true\n        updateTrackingMode()\n    }\n    \n    func stopTracking() {\n        debugLog(\"stopTracking called\")\n        isTracking = false\n        locationManager.stopUpdatingLocation()\n        locationManager.stopMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges()\n        stopForegroundLocationTimer()\n    }\n    \n    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState",

Properties\n    @Published var disableDeviceAutolock: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(disableDeviceAutolock, forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) }\n    }\n    @Published var indicateAccuracyOnMap: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(indicateAccuracyOnMap, forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) }\n    }\n    @Published var groupsZoomToFit: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(groupsZoomToFit, forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) }\n    }\n    @Published var miataruServerURL: String {\n        didSet {\n            defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(\n                serverURL: miataruServerURL,\n                deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\n                ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var trackAndReportLocation: Bool {\n        didSet { \n            defaults.set(trackAndReportLocation, forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation)\n            // Check location permissions when tracking is enabled\n            if trackAndReportLocation {\n                checkAndRequestLocationPermissions()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var saveLocationHistoryOnServer: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(saveLocationHistoryOnServer, forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) }\n    }\n    @Published var locationDataRetentionTime: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(locationDataRetentionTime), forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") }\n    }\n    @Published var mapType: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapType), forKey: Keys.mapType) }\n    }\n    @Published var mapUpdateInterval: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapUpdateInterval), forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) }",

        "contents": "    private func checkAndRequestLocationPermissions() {\n        // Reuse the existing LocationManager instance instead of creating a duplicate\n        LocationManager.shared.requestLocationPermission()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Initialwerte laden\n    init() {\n        let d = UserDefaults.standard\n        self.disableDeviceAutolock = d.object(forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.indicateAccuracyOnMap = d.object(forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) as? Bool ?? true\n        self.groupsZoomToFit = d.object(forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) as? Bool ?? true\n        self.miataruServerURL = d.string(forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL) ?? \"https://service.miataru.com\"\n        self.trackAndReportLocation = d.object(forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.saveLocationHistoryOnServer = d.object(forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.locationDataRetentionTime = Int(d.string(forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") ?? \"1440\") ?? 1440\n        self.mapType = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.mapType) ?? \"1\") ?? 1\n        self.mapUpdateInterval = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) ?? \"30\") ?? 30\n        self.mapZoomLevel = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.mapZoomLevel) ?? \"1\") ?? 1\n        self.historyNumberOfDays = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.historyNumberOfDays) ?? \"10000000\") ?? 10000000\n        self.locationActivityType = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.locationActivityType) ?? \"0\") ?? 0\n        self.locationSensitivityLevel = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.locationSensitivityLevel) ?? \"2\") ?? 2\n        self.autoRefreshDeviceList = d.object(forKey: Keys.autoRefreshDeviceList) as? Bool ?? true\n        self.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices = d.object(forKey: Keys.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.showRouteProgress = d.object(forKey: Keys.showRouteProgress) as? Bool ?? false\n        self.lastOpenedDeviceID = d.string(forKey: Keys.lastOpenedDeviceID)\n        // Default: 1000m, Off=0, 100m=100, 10km=10000\n        self.reverseGeocodingThresholdMeters = Int(d.string(forKey: Keys.reverseGeocodingThresholdMeters) ?? \"1000\") ?? 1000",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "    \n    @objc private func appDidBecomeActive() {\n        debugLog(\"App did become active\")\n        // Re-check permission escalation / first-time prompt if needed\n        ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded()\n        if isTracking {\n            startHighAccuracyUpdates()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Settings Observer\n    private func observeSettings() {\n        settings.$trackAndReportLocation\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] shouldTrack in\n                guard let self else { return }\n                if shouldTrack {\n                    self.startTracking()\n                } else {\n                    self.stopTracking()\n                }\n            }\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private func observeActivityType() {\n        settings.$locationActivityType\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] newValue in\n                guard let self = self else { return }\n                self.locationManager.activityType = Self.activityTypeFrom(newValue)\n                if self.isTracking {\n                    // Restart location updates to apply new activityType immediately\n                    self.updateTrackingMode()\n                }\n            }\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private static func activityTypeFrom(_ value: Int) -&gt; CLActivityType {\n        switch value {\n        case 1: return .automotiveNavigation\n        case 2: return .fitness\n        case 3: return .otherNavigation\n        case 4:\n#if swift(&gt;=5.0)\n            if #available(iOS 12.0, *) {\n                return .airborne\n            } else {\n                return .other\n            }\n#else\n            return .other\n#endif\n        default: return .other\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Permissions",

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="edit_file_v2">

Zusammenfassung der Änderungen:

## Zusammenfassung

**Problem:** Nach Verweigerung der Standortberechtigung konnte der Toggle nicht erneut aktiviert werden, um die Berechtigung erneut anzufragen.

**Lösung:**
1. `requestLocationPermission()` erweitert: Bei verweigerter Berechtigung (`.denied` oder `.restricted`) öffnet die App die iOS-Einstellungen, damit der Benutzer die Berechtigung dort ändern kann.
2. Neue Methode `openAppSettings()`: Öffnet die App-Einstellungen.
3. Toggle-Logik: Beim Aktivieren wird immer `requestLocationPermission()` aufgerufen. Wenn die Berechtigung verweigert wurde, öffnen sich die Einstellungen.
4. Prüfung beim App-Wechsel ins Vordergrund: In `appDidBecomeActive()` wird der Berechtigungsstatus geprüft. Wenn die Berechtigung weiterhin verweigert ist, wird der Toggle auf `false` gesetzt.

**Ablauf:**
1. Benutzer verweigert Berechtigung → Toggle wird auf `false` gesetzt
2. Benutzer aktiviert Toggle erneut → Toggle wird auf `true` gesetzt → `requestLocationPermission()` wird aufgerufen
3. Wenn Berechtigung verweigert wurde → Einstellungen öffnen sich
4. Benutzer kehrt zurück:
   - Wenn Berechtigung erteilt wurde → Tracking startet automatisch
   - Wenn Berechtigung weiterhin verweigert wurde → Toggle wird automatisch auf `false` gesetzt

Der Benutzer kann den Toggle erneut aktivieren, um die Berechtigung erneut anzufragen oder die Einstellungen zu öffnen.

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

Please try again.\")\n                )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func openInAppleMaps() {\n        // Open the route in the Apple Maps app using the selected transport type\n        guard let dest = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        let source: MKMapItem\n        let destination: MKMapItem\n        if isRouteReversed {\n            source = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\n            source.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\n            destination = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\n        } else {\n            source = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\n            destination = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\n            destination.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\n        }\n        var options: [String: Any] = [:]\n        switch settings.navigationTransportType {\n        case 0: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeWalking\n        case 3: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeTransit\n        default: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeDriving\n        }\n        MKMapItem.openMaps(with: [source, destination], launchOptions: options)\n    }\n\n    private func transportTypeFromSetting(_ value: Int) -&gt; MKDirectionsTransportType {\n        switch value {\n        case 0: return .walking\n        case 3: return .transit\n        default: return .automobile\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)",

Die Implementierung sollte funktionieren. Die Fehlermeldung "app-prefs:com.miataru.ios" ist ungewöhnlich; `UIApplication.openSettingsURLString` sollte "app-settings:" zurückgeben.

**Zusammenfassung der Änderungen:**

1. **Main Thread**: Der Aufruf erfolgt in einem `Task { @MainActor in }` Block, um sicherzustellen, dass er auf dem Main Thread ausgeführt wird.

2. **Bessere Fehlerbehandlung**: Logging hinzugefügt, um zu sehen, was passiert.

3. **Kompatibilität**: Unterstützung für iOS 10+ mit Completion Handler und Fallback für ältere Versionen.

Die Implementierung sollte funktionieren. Falls der Fehler weiterhin auftritt, könnte es ein Systemproblem sein. Die Logs zeigen, was passiert.

        "contents": "# Cursor Rules for miataru iOS App\n\n## Project Context\nThis is an open-source iOS application for privacy-friendly location tracking, sharing, and device management. Built with SwiftUI and modern iOS frameworks (iOS 18 and iOS 26).\n\n## Code Style &amp; Standards\n- Use SwiftUI best practices\n- Follow iOS Human Interface Guidelines\n- Maintain privacy-first approach\n- Use English for all code comments and strings\n- Implement proper error handling and battery optimization\n\n## Architecture Guidelines\n- Use ObservableObject and @Published for state management\n- Keep views lightweight and delegate business logic to managers\n- Implement proper MVVM pattern\n- Use UserDefaults for settings persistence\n- Handle location permissions gracefully\n\n## Key Components\n- LocationManager: Handles location tracking and permissions\n- SettingsManager: Manages user preferences\n- Device management and QR code functionality\n- Multi-platform support (iPhone, iPad, Mac)\n\n## Development Workflow\n- Test on multiple device types\n- Consider battery optimization\n- Maintain privacy compliance\n- Follow iOS app store guidelines\n\n## Common Patterns\n- Use @StateObject for view models\n- Implement proper onboarding flow\n- Handle background/foreground transitions\n- Manage device identifiers securely\n\n## Localization Guidelines\n\n### String Localization\n**ALWAYS** use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; for all user-facing text strings with proper English descriptions.\n\n#### ✅ Correct Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nText(NSLocalizedString(\"no_groups_available_create_new\", comment: \"No groups available. Zusammenfassung der Änderungen:

## Zusammenfassung

**Problem:** Beim Aktivieren des Toggles bei verweigerter Berechtigung öffnete sich die Einstellungen direkt, ohne Erklärung.

**Lösung:**
1. Alert-Dialog hinzugefügt: Zeigt eine Erklärung, warum die Einstellungen geöffnet werden.
2. Optionen: "Abbrechen" (hält den Toggle aus) und "Einstellungen öffnen" (öffnet die Einstellungen).
3. Lokalisierung: Alle Texte in 10 Sprachen hinzugefügt:
   - Englisch, Dänisch, Deutsch, Spanisch, Finnisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Japanisch, Niederländisch, Chinesisch

**Ablauf:**
1. Benutzer aktiviert Toggle → Prüfung, ob Berechtigung verweigert wurde
2. Wenn verweigert → Alert wird angezeigt mit:
   - Titel: "Einstellungen öffnen"
   - Nachricht: Erklärung, warum die Einstellungen geöffnet werden
   - Buttons: "Abbrechen" und "Einstellungen öffnen"
3. Benutzer wählt:
   - "Abbrechen" → Toggle bleibt aus
   - "Einstellungen öffnen" → Toggle wird aktiviert und Einstellungen öffnen sich

**Geänderte Dateien:**
- `iPhone_2_OnboardingPermissionsView.swift`: Alert-Logik hinzugefügt
- `LocationManager.swift`: `openAppSettings()` öffentlich gemacht
- `Localizable.xcstrings`: 3 neue Lokalisierungskeys mit Übersetzungen hinzugefügt

Der Benutzer sieht jetzt einen Dialog, bevor die Einstellungen geöffnet werden, und kann die Aktion abbrechen oder fortsetzen.
